segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers report the scrub as effective against occasional breakouts and blackheads, though one found it also dried her out.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers generally describe it as moisturizing and non-drying, removing flakes and dry patches, though a couple found it too drying or too harsh for extremely dry skin.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers (including oily-T-zone/dry-face patterns) report smoother texture and fewer clogged pores, but one with sensitive combination skin experienced painful breakouts.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several say it is gentle enough for regular use with no irritation, while others report it caused redness, flaking, or breakouts and would not recommend it for sensitive skin.
segments.normal: The few reviewers who do not specify a particular concern mainly praise smoothness and softness after use.
segments.mature: One reviewer with older/mature skin found it gentle and left a smooth base for makeup, and another credits it with keeping wrinkles at bay.

concerns.aging: A small number of reviewers mention smoother texture, more even tone, or a sense that wrinkles are kept at bay, but no reviewer reports a dramatic anti-aging change.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the scrub as moisturizing or non-drying, clearing flakes and dry patches, but several others explicitly report it dried their skin out or worsened flaking.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports the product caused extreme redness around the nose that took a month to heal, while another says it reduced the redness and dryness she usually gets from scrubs.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers with already sensitive or damaged skin say it felt too harsh, made skin hurt or flake immediately, while others with sensitive skin report no irritation at all.
concerns.spots: Reviewers using it for blackheads and dark spots report pores looking smaller and blackheads reduced or gone, and one notes dark spots visibly diminishing after a few uses.
concerns.blemishes: Many acne-prone reviewers report fewer breakouts, faster healing of pimples, and reduced scarring; however, several others state it broke them out, including one describing worsened acne and one whose daughter's clear skin broke out after starting the product.
concerns.oiliness: A couple of oily-skin reviewers report their skin became less oily and pimples appeared less often, though one oily reviewer said it dried her skin without improving oiliness.
